<bbm-response>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_0">"Try using spatial movement on me, but please give me a heads-up after the calculations are done and right before you actually move me."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_1">"No problem, dess."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_2">${白井黑子} walked over and placed her hand on ${一色}'s shoulder.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_3">"Lord ${一色}, are you ready?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_4">"OK, please activate it." ${一色} used ${净化}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_5">"Eh?" ${白井黑子} appeared in the distance, while ${一色} stayed in place.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_6">That's a rare teleportation failure.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_7">"Based on my ability's judgment, ${白井黑子}'s coordinate calculations for me were probably flagged as a tag, so I suppose I can nullify other people's specific espers to a certain extent. Anyway, things like placing tags and mind control definitely won't work on me."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_8">${白井黑子} flashed back to her original spot in another blink, her small hand grasping empty air as she remained somewhat incredulous.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_9">"I see," ${御坂美琴} murmured thoughtfully. "But wouldn't it be a bit troublesome if ${食蜂操祈} tampered with your common sense and made you define the effects she applied to you as normal?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_10">"That won't happen. Senior ${食蜂操祈} only used mind control, memory-reading, and mind-reading abilities on me. Mind control gets classified by me as hypnosis, and I have a prop similar to an unconditioned reflex that can grant immunity to control."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_11">As she spoke, ${一色} materialized quicksilver in the palm of her hand, resembling an upside-down dark-green cup.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_12">"Whoa, that's something I've never seen before," ${御坂美琴} exclaimed in wonder.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_13">"${白井黑子} remembers that Lord ${一色}'s equipment needs to be worn for the effect to work, dess."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_14">"It's had a massive upgrade now! Not only has the effect evolved, but the way it's used is much more convenient too." A pair of yellow boots with small wings surfaced in ${一色}'s hands, and she instantly refined them into a golden light that sank into ${御坂美琴}'s body.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_15">"Whoa, what's going on? ${一色}, don't go putting strange things into my body!" ${御坂美琴} checked herself up and down.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_16">"Relax, relax. Big sis, hurry up and try running a bit." ${一色} pushed ${御坂美琴}'s back.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_17">"Eh—fine, I'll give it a try." ${御坂美琴} broke into a light jog, finding that she effortlessly reached her previous top running speed, and exerting strength through her feet pushed her speed to an even higher level.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_18">"It really works!" ${御坂美琴} stopped in her tracks, looked back at ${一色} and ${白井黑子}, and waved at them. Within three to four seconds, she had already run about fifty meters.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_19">${一色} conjured a pair of red long boots with blue edges, turned them into a ball of light, and tossed it into ${白井黑子}'s arms.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_20">${白井黑子} blinked.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_21">"Try activating your ability." ${一色} winked.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_22">"What kind of effect does this have?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_23">"It increases movement speed a bit and reduces spellcasting cooldowns. In short, you run faster, and ${白井黑子} can use spatial movement more frequently. As for the operational mechanism, though, it probably boosts ${白井黑子}'s calculation capacity?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_24">"I see. In that case, ${白井黑子} will give it a try."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_25">${白井黑子} blinked five times between the two endpoints of ${御坂美琴} and ${一色}, finally stopping beside ${御坂美琴} and muttering to herself, "It really did get faster. It comprehensively enhanced ability activation and calculation efficiency, and the drain on ${白井黑子}'s mental power hasn't really changed."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_26">"${原石} abilities are truly incredible," ${御坂美琴} sighed with emotion.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_27">${一色} chased after them: "This is just the tip of the iceberg."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_28">${御坂美琴} raised a hand to stroke ${一色}'s head: "That's quite impressive."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_29">${白井黑子} showed intense interest in ${一色}'s ability, pressing on with questions: "Lord ${一色}, may I ask what the duration and effective range of your ability are? Can a single person trigger multiple effects simultaneously?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_30">"I haven't tested the duration and range. I can wear multiple pieces of equipment myself, but for anyone other than me, can we only give them one for now?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_31">"Even so, such high versatility and efficacy easily reach the level of a Level 4 Major Esper."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_32">"Congratulations, ${一色}! Double the joy. There's a physical examination in a couple of days, so we can verify just how far you've reached then!"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_33">"Ahaha, this is actually just part of my ability... Hehe, anyway, who knows, I might even end up stronger than big sis? By then, I'll really be the one covering you, big sis."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_34">"Eh—you sure talk big, considering you're mere kid sister."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_35">"Hehe."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_36">Chapter 22: Is this a giant scholar?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_37">Passing through several blocks of ${学园之舍}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_38">${一色} finally set foot on the soil of ${常盘台中学}, and her long-awaited junior high school girl life begins now.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p8604020e0b54_39">${常盘台中学}, a cradle for espers renowned for cultivating high-level espers, requires students to reach at least ${Level3} in order to enroll. The most representative figures among the students are none other than ${御坂美琴} and ${食蜂操祈}.</bbm-unit>
</bbm-response>
